# FNB-ETAF feature and step-definition guidance

- Keep Gherkin business-readable. Use existing steps before adding a new step definition.
- A new step must map cleanly to a Java binding, a focused framework/page/business method, and approved YAML/configuration resources.
- Use has value for input, textarea, or select value verification. Use contain/text assertions only for visible text content, labels, headings, messages, buttons, or table cells.
- Do not embed CSS/XPath selectors, credentials, tokens, large request bodies, query text, internal URLs, or customer data in feature files.
- Preserve @LastScenario semantics and explicit close-all-browsers sequencing. Do not change scenario lifecycle behavior to fix a feature-only problem.
- Keep API and performance routes relative when the existing target configuration assembles the host, protocol, port, or base path.
